items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: It was up in Salem, Oregon, run by Bill and Mary Brown, and it was in this gorgeous setting overlooking the Pacific.

ctx.x: Oh it’s a wonderful one. It was up in Salem, Oregon, run by Bill and Mary Brown, and it was in this gorgeous setting overlooking the Pacific. What a beautiful party. And all of a sudden all these wonderful players come from all over and we’d get together in this idyllic little resort, overlooking the Pacific, and there are seals down on the rocks down below and stuff, and just that northern coastline — the northern California/Oregon coastline, which is overwhelming to a person from the east who’s never really…
As it is at most of them.
